info.name: Beautifully Simple API
info.description:
Run the folders in order: Users, Subjects, Packages, Requests, Subscriptions, Cleanup.
Default accounts match `npm run seed`. Change them in the collection Variables if needed.
Requests with file fields need you to pick files in the Body tab (Postman does not export file paths).
Packages sets packageId, so Create - package no longer needs a seeded package.
Lists accept page and limit (default 20, max 100) and return pagination.

request.description: `data` holds the whole subject. Each `lecture_<order>` field holds that lecture's PDFs (repeat the key for more files). Field order does not matter.

item.name: Create subject - JSON only, no files (admin)

request.description: A subject without files can still be sent as plain JSON.
`data` = lecture JSON (title, order, description, quiz). `files` = PDFs for this lecture.
Adds PDFs to an existing lecture. Field: files (up to 10, 20MB each).

item.description:
GET routes are public (catalog without answers or links). Admin token returns the full subject.
Everything else is admin-only and checked before any file is saved.
Create subject / Add lecture use form-data: `data` = JSON text, PDFs in `lecture_<order>` (subject) or `files` (lecture).
Saved file name: subjectName-lectureNumber-uniqueID.pdf in Cloudinary folder beautifully_simple.

item.name: Packages
item.description:
Admin creates and edits packages. Students only see published ones.
durationDays is a number of days (same unit as subjects).
A package in an active subscription cannot be deleted.
Run after Subjects: subjectId comes from Create subject.

request.description: Creates the subscription: endAt = now + subject durationDays, enrollment = every lecture of the subject.
A student can cancel their own request only while it is reviewing or returned.

item.description:
userId always comes from the token. A new request is always saved as reviewing.
Target: subjectId, or subjectId + lectureId, or packageId. paymentProof = jpeg/png/webp image up to 5MB.
Student can edit only their own request and only when it is returned.
Admin decides with PATCH /requests/:id/review { decision: approved | rejected | returned, adminNotes }.
adminNotes is required for rejected / returned. Approving creates the subscription with its enrollment.
Approved requests cannot be deleted.

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description:
Created only by approving a request. Each subscription holds its enrollment:
subjects -> lectures (completed, completedAt, quizAttempt) + finalQuizAttempt.
Progress and quizzes: owner student only, active subscription only. Each quiz has one attempt, graded on the server.
Subscriptions past endAt become expired when read.
Lecture content / PDFs / final quiz questions live under /subjects and need an active subscription (admin always allowed).

request.description: Files list (no links) and quiz questions without correct answers.
